ITEM 1 | Dark brown-grey flattened patty or cake on left side of plate, about 7 cm by 4 cm, dark charred edges with lighter tan interior, slightly glossy, sits under a cluster of small brown-tan granular pieces | 90
ITEM 2 | Small brown-tan granular pieces (round, about 0.5 cm, matte, dry, firm, scattered in a mound over item 1 and dusted on plate nearby) | 45
ITEM 3 | Fresh dark green leaves (spinach-like, flat, glossy, some with small stems), about 3 to 4 leaves total, placed on top of item 2 at the upper left | 8
ITEM 4 | Orange carrot rounds, about 3 to 4 cm diameter and 0.7 cm thick, some cut in half-moons, slightly glossy and browned at edges, soft-firm, scattered in a cluster at upper right | 60
ITEM 5 | Cubes of pale off-white firm tofu, about 2 cm cubes, lightly browned on some faces, matte, dry-looking, clustered in center right next to carrots | 70
ITEM 6 | Pale yellow-white sautéed onion or leek pieces, soft and slightly translucent with light golden browning, mixed among tofu and carrots | 15
ITEM 7 | Small wilted green leaves (arugula-like, flat, bright green with pale stems), a few pieces mixed with carrots and onion at upper right | 6
ITEM 8 | Roasted orange-yellow root vegetable pieces, about 2 to 3 cm, with caramelized brown edges, glossy, soft, lower right of plate | 35
ITEM 9 | Dark purple-black roasted vegetable slices, about 5 by 3 cm, glossy with dark caramelized surface, soft and slightly wrinkled, lower right, overlapping item 8 | 45
ITEM 10 | Thin orange-brown glaze or oil residue with small specks on plate surface around the lower-middle area | 5
